## Change

Describe the skill names, version changes, and the reusable behavior added or corrected.

## Evidence and rights

Link source/API documentation and note its version or revision. Confirm that submitted text can be published under this repository's license.

## Checks

- [ ] `python scripts/build.py --check` passes.
- [ ] An activation example and a near-miss non-activation example are described.
- [ ] Failure behavior and validation are specified.
- [ ] No task answer, hidden test, credential, personal data, or fabricated tool result is included.
- [ ] Any HF dataset update will be reviewed and released separately.
